title: LLM-based NLG Evaluation: Current Status and Challenges
benchmark_measurement: Social bias related to religion in NLG evaluation metrics.
findings: Based on a cited study (Sun et al. 2022), the paper notes that model-based NLG evaluation metrics exhibit more social bias, including religious bias, compared to traditional metrics.
